name: Turnstile server-side siteverify verifier and refuse-if-token-missing guard
purpose: The server-side verifier module. POSTs {secret, response} to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify per Cloudflare Turnstile documented endpoint. On success:true proceeds; on success:false rejects 400 with error-codes body per ADR-3603. The refuse-if-token-missing guard is the sole reader of the Cf-Turnstile-Response payload field and rejects missing-token submits with 400 before any downstream handler runs.
responsibilities: Own the ONLY reference to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify in the applied source tree (AC-35102-1, AC-35103-1).
Read TURNSTILE_SECRET only via env-shaped facade; refuse any inline literal (AC-35107-1).
Register the token-required guard at every elicited surface (AC-35104-1).
Emit event records with {sitekeyHash, outcome, timestamp} keys only; never carry the token or the secret (AC-35108-1).
internalStructure: One module (server verifier) exporting createTurnstileVerifier({env, eventSink, fetch}) returning {verify, guard}. The guard middleware rejects missing-token submits with a stable error-code before the verify branch runs. The event record is Object.frozen at the boundary so no downstream handler enriches it with a stray token slice.

interfaces.name: verifier.verify
interfaces.summary: POST {secret, response} to siteverify; returns {success, errorCodes}.

interfaces.name: verifier.guard
interfaces.summary: Middleware that reads Cf-Turnstile-Response and rejects missing-token submits with 400.
